changelog:
- Initial release of the design-to-html skill.
- Converts visual design mockups or images into pixel-perfect HTML/CSS code through an automated, iterative refinement workflow.
- Includes step-by-step process with visual comparison, diff reports, and optimization instructions.
- Supports command-line interface for running analysis, rendering, comparison, and pipeline scripts.
- Provides setup instructions, examples for common design types, tips, and outlines current limitations.
summary: Convert design images to pixel-perfect HTML/CSS by analyzing layout, colors, fonts, then iteratively refining code through automated visual comparison.
